'''Helina Dow''' was a [[Genian (species)|Genian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] hired by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was also [[Talesan Fry]]'s Executive in charge of production and distribution.

==Biography==
Helina Dow worked for [[Talesan Fry]] at his [[Fry Industries|surveillance production company]]. Secretly a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], she was planted in the complex early on in its development. When Talesan created the codebreaker, she made an attempt to steal it from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] agents [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The attempt was foiled, however, and Helina was subsequently killed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Magus (bounty hunter)|Magus]], due to the fact that having failed to steal the codebreaker she had become a liability.
